verdict.rationale: The evidence documents general Internal Agent automations that run on a schedule or a trigger, plus knowledge version history. Nothing states that knowledge sources are automatically re-synced on a schedule or when they change. Automations that "surface gaps" only flag problems and do not refresh knowledge. A generic scheduled-task feature a user could point at knowledge updates is an adjacent building block, not a documented knowledge-sync capability.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, knowledge stays current automatically — the agent re-syncs sources on a schedule or on change, not via manual re-uploads
